summary: Marqii, an NYC-based digital-operations platform for restaurants, bars, hotels and ghost kitchens managing online menus, listings, and review responses, secured $10 million in new funding in October 2024 (led by Next Coast Ventures, with Rich Products Ventures and existing investor Maccabee Ventures participating), bringing total funding raised to $20 million.
Marqii is led by co-founder and CEO Avi Goren, alongside co-founders Evan Perlmutter and Bryan Rutcofsky.

Marqii's named restaurant customers include P. Terry's, Authentic Restaurant Brands, &pizza, DIG, Margaritaville, Levain, Cooper's Hawk, Big Chicken, Birdcall, Insomnia Cookies, and Punchbowl Social; the company grew to over 12,000 restaurant-operator locations (a 50% increase) by adding 4,000 new locations between October 2023 and October 2024, with roughly one-third of clients operating 30+ locations.

Marqii's AI Suggested Review Response feature was used to respond to over 11,000 customer reviews within a two-month period, saving operators an estimated 180+ hours of manual review-response work. (Scope note: Aggregate platform-wide usage statistic, not attributed to a single named operator's ROI.)
